items.prompt: Why must a strategy still check availability after this loader sorts accepted rows?

options.why: Ordering does not establish source trust.

options.text: The loader already trades every row at its event time
options.why: No strategy or external trading action occurs here.

options.text: All sorted data is automatically known from the beginning
Event order does not prove information was available
options.why: Historical use needs the decision-time information set.

items.explanation: Sorting a dataset and restricting its usable information set are distinct operations. Keep availability/freshness checks in the downstream contract.
